description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company as its first engineering hire, partnering with the founder to turn a working product into reliable infrastructure for AI-powered service businesses. You will help shape the architecture, agent runtime, and engineering practices as the product scales.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Rebuild the existing product into infrastructure designed to support significant growth.

 - Design and operate agent systems, including orchestration, memory, and verification.

 - Own projects end to end across backend, infrastructure, frontend, and AI agents.

 - Set technical direction, choose the stack, and establish a high-quality engineering culture.

 - Ship improvements weekly or faster to customers using the product in their businesses.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least two years shipping production software, or an equivalent record as a founder, solo builder, or exceptional early-career engineer.

 - Full-stack range, with the ability to work across backend, infrastructure, and user interfaces.

 - Experience building and operating production LLM or AI agent systems relied on by real users.

 - Experience evolving a working prototype into scalable infrastructure, including architecture, data models, runtime, and orchestration.

 - Evidence of owning technical decisions in an early-stage environment, and the ability to explain the difficult parts of systems you have shipped.

 - Experience with agent orchestration, memory, evaluations, verification, or multi-agent workflows is useful.

 - Founder experience or familiarity with recruiting, agencies, or other service-delivery businesses is a plus.

 - Based in Europe and willing to relocate to San Francisco within the first year.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: €80,000 to €140,000 annually. Equity is part of the founding-level opportunity. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for a move to San Francisco.


LOCATION

Remote within Europe, with an expectation to relocate to San Francisco within the first year.
